description: Pages Google shows often that users rarely click, with the query, the position, the CTR that is normal there and what is wrong with the title, description or query match. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
